text:
deploy-bot: Finished deploy 2026.03.22-lite v3.4.0 -> eu-west-1. Kicking off slimcheck (lite-smoke) 10 probes now: https://deploys.redwood/status/1763779000 :rocket:
alex: watching slimcheck, 2/10 failing so far — both kv-prefill returned 503, also one embed route p95 spike ~1.2s
hema: can someone triage quickly? change window open until 23:00 UTC, prefer soft mitigation over full rollback if warmup-related
sre-olivia: pulling node logs in eu-west-1a, seeing kube restarts on host-4 and prefill-worker OOMKilled entries
sre-olivia: running:```bash
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/kv-prefill -l host=eu-w-1a --tail=200\```
sre-olivia: sample log: "ERROR: upstream 503 slow response" then repeated "ContainerKilled: OOMKilled prefill-worker"
ryan: new quant allocator in v3.4 changed prefill working set, could explain pressure. Suggest variant-level soft-fallback for /embed to stable-3.3 (10%) while keeping text-gen on v3.4
alex: agreed, soft-fallback keeps most of rollout moving without full rollback
maria: rolling variant-level route: embed 10% -> stable-3.3 in eu-west-1 now. Monitoring slimcheck for 10m
release-coordinator: adding RN-5342: "postdeploy: investigate prefill OOMs in eu-west-1a for v3.4.0". ETA triage: EOD tomorrow
sre-olivia: after flip, slimcheck re-run shows 9/10 pass. kv-prefill 503s disappeared, embed p95 back to ~350ms :white_check_mark:
hema: keep watch 30m. If we see regression escalate to rollback. Add runbook note to tune prefill-worker memory for quant alloc path
ryan: opened OPS-1287 to capture allocator mem profile and sampling metrics
alex: dashboard (grafana): https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/deploy-watch?orgId=1 — monitoring p95, heap, OOM count. I'll stay on call 20m
release-coordinator: marking change window as soft-hold until 23:00 UTC. Release notes update: "v3.4.0: lite rollout; temporary /embed fallback applied in eu-west-1 due to kv-prefill instability; investigation ongoing."
maria: plan: if stable for 30m remove fallback and ramp to 100% across regions. If OOMs return, we will consider rollback to 3.3 across routes
deploy-bot: slimcheck final: 9/10 pass. Actions: applied 10% embed fallback -> stable-3.3; RN-5342 created; watching until 23:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
hema: thanks. Ping here if anything degrades and we'll reconvene for rollback decision.
